note: Chickasaw County Conservation park of 57 acres northwest of New Hampton beside the airport, on a 9-acre stocked fishing lake with a swim beach, boat ramp, shelter, playground and hiking trail. The property is leased from the City of New Hampton. The campground sits north of the lake; the south row (66-70) looks across the loop road and a grass strip to it. --Claude
summary: Rates ($22/$27), 70 sites, 30/50-amp electric with sewer on 10-30, season May 1-Oct 15, half reservable with 2/3-night weekend/holiday minimums all confirmed. Waterfront lakefront -> lakeview. Pin is 465 m south of the campground.
flags: WATERFRONT lakefront -> lakeview: the campground is north of the 9-acre lake, not on it. The nearest pads, the south row 66-70 on the operator's campground map, are about 60-70 m from the lake's north shore (NAIP), with the campground road and a grass and brush strip between. The official photo of site 68 shows the lake across the road and lawn, so those sites earn a view. No pad is within a pad's depth of open shore. The swim beach and boat ramp on the lake are day use south of the campground. The old lakefront call had no per-entry evidence and was probably read at the stored pin, which sits on the lake's south shore by the beach.
PIN (lead): the stored 43.08575,-92.34685 is on the lake's south shore by the beach and boat ramp, about 465 m from the campground. The campground's centre is about 43.0899,-92.3465 (NAIP).

SEASONAL (lead, local so no gate): the county's campgrounds page links a 'Seasonal Campsite Application' and a 'Monthly Camping Application'. NAIP (summer) shows the north rows 10-30 lined with RVs. Nightly camping is plainly sold: half the sites book online by the night and half are first come, first served. Not read as mostly seasonal.
DISCOUNT: the old note's 'Veterans -$2/day' is not on any page I read (park page, site pages, county rates page). It was dropped from the note. No discounts group was written.
FIT OK: the site pages describe gravel back-ins about 50-55 ft deep with 30 and 50 amp.
PHONE OK: 641-394-4714 is the Chickasaw County Conservation office (park page and county page). Website: the county campgrounds page and mycountyparks are both the operator's, fine as stored.
